requirements.quote: R12: the routine documents lawyers actually produce (early-listing memo, memo of appearance, application for certified copy, request for adjournment note, covering letter to junior or senior counsel).
requirements.why: The v1 catalogue table lists no counsel covering letter, and it needs a non-client recipient slot that the client-letter rule forbids; file as a follow-up with its own recipient model.

requirements.quote: R14: Wording is reviewed by a practising advocate fixture-holder before the flag-free release
requirements.why: Advocate review of wording can only happen on the released scaffolds; the banner stays until reviewed_by is set.

preserve.what: Scaffold banner behaviour: packages/core/src/drafting/export.ts bannerShown stays true while template.reviewed_by is null

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/core exec vitest run src/drafting/__tests__/policy.test.ts src/drafting/__tests__/drafting.integration.test.ts -t bannerShown --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-1}
